name: feepass
description: Send PUSD on Bitcoin Cash with no spendable BCH: a CashScript covenant pays the miner fee, you pay it in dollars.

scripts.build: npm run build:api && vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:api:
esbuild src/server/function.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=api/feepass.mjs --legal-comments=none --banner:js="// GENERATED by npm run build:api from src/server/function.ts. Do not edit.
import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run e2e
